title: Weekly check-in
introSubtitle: Ten minutes. Each of you answers privately first.
questions: What do you want us to do together?
Did anything weigh on you this week?
What do you want me to know?
answerHint: Write as much or as little as you want.
privateNote: Answers stay hidden until both of you finish.
skipNote: Skipping leaves this question blank. The check-in only appears when both of you answer all four.
waitingText: Answers appear when both of you have answered all four.
waitingIncomplete: Some questions are still blank. Answers appear when both of you answer all four.
discardText: The text you wrote was not saved.
revealSubtitle: Now that you both finished, both answers to each question are shown.
revealNote: No scores. Just what each of you wrote.
soloTitle: The check-in is for both of you
soloText: When your person joins, the weekly check-in shows up here.

errors(map).other: Couldn't save that now. Try again.
